text: dsh-session-title-live 是一个面向 DSH 的会话标题插件：它在会话标题服务中注册自动 provider，并在用户继续对话时刷新标题，也可在回合开始和结束时加上状态前缀。它会保护人工改名，支持从只读主线账本直接取标题，并可调整输入字节预算、最小更新门槛和模型路由。适合希望侧边栏标题持续反映长会话内容、同时辨认运行状态的 DSH 用户。需要兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js；默认沿用会话模型路由。

dsh-session-title-live refreshes DSH titles as chats continue and adds running or complete turn prefixes. It preserves manually pinned titles and can use task names from a read-only mainline ledger. It requires compatible DSH and Node.js and follows the session model route by default.
想让 DSH 的会话标题在后续聊天中持续跟着内容变化。
有没有办法让侧边栏标题概括最近几轮对话，而不是只看第一句话？
让会话一开始显示运行中，结束后自动显示完成。
我手动改过的会话标题能不能固定住，不再被自动摘要覆盖？
希望已有主线任务名称的会话直接用主线名当标题。
短消息比如“好”不要触发标题重写，能设置更新门槛吗？
Keep session titles up to date as a conversation continues.
Can my DSH sidebar show whether a turn is running or complete?
dsh-session-title-live 的功能「live-title」：会话标题实时更新：每条用户消息后依据预算内的近期人类消息生成标题，并通过 DSH 标题服务写回；可配置专用模型路由。
dsh-session-title-live 的功能「turn-state」：回合状态前缀：监听回合开始与结束，为标题分别加上运行或完成状态前缀；文案可配置，也可关闭。
dsh-session-title-live 的功能「mainline」：主线名称直写：匹配只读账本中的会话时直接将主线名作为标题；账本缺失或冲突时回到自动生成。
dsh-session-title-live 的功能「pin」：人工标题保护：识别用户手动改名并停止自动覆盖；会话创建时预置的标题可继续参与自动处理。
dsh-session-title-live 使用 DSH 的 LLM 流式服务生成标题；默认沿用会话记录的模型路由，也可配置 provider 与 model 成对使用。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · dsh-session-title-live：> ### 这是什么
> **一个小插件**：让会话标题实时反映状态（运行中 / 已完成），并且不会把已 pin 的标题搞乱。
>
> ### 它解决什么
> 侧边栏里十几个会话，光看标题分不出"正在干活"和"早就结束了"。这个插件把状态前缀直接写进标题，并且把"自动改标题"和"用户手工 pin"这两件事分开处理 —— 你 pin 住的标题它不碰。
>
> ### 一条命令跑起来
> ```powershell
> dsh plugin --profile web add @kira905/dsh-session-title-live
> ```
> 装完标题就会自己带状态前缀；规则可通过插件设置调整。
>
> ### 它长什么样
> 侧边栏标题变成「【运行】…」/「【完成】…」这种形态。⚠️ 本仓**暂无截图**。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · dsh-session-title-live：> ### 它不附带什么（先看清楚，省得装完失望）
>
> 这套开源出来的是**能用的工具 + 装完自检 + 设计文档**。有两块**不在开源范围里**：
>
> 1. **「自己盯着活干」的那套引擎**：定时调度、队列盯守、管家日报、自主决定要不要动手 —— 这几件还没整理出来放（整理完会陆续放）。它的**设计本身是公开的**，写在 [`ops-handoff-design`](https://github.com/kira905/ops-handoff-design) 仓里，想自己实现的人照着做得到。
> 2. **「出事喊到人」的通道**：企业微信、语音播报这类 —— **不随开源发布**。
>
> 所以：装完你拿到的是一套**能用的工具**，不是一个会自己上班的管家。

> **English**: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

一个 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件**：让会话标题**跟着对话实时更新**。
section: ③ 本仓是插件、没有命令入口 —— 跳过这一步（判据看 ① 与 ②）

text:
@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 为什么需要它：DSH 自带的标题机制只在**会话第一条用户消息**时生成一次标题（`automatic: "first-prompt"`）。
长会话聊到十几轮之后，侧边栏显示的还是开头那句话，跟会话实际内容完全脱节 ——
而会话列表恰恰是你找会话的唯一入口。

本插件注册一个 `automatic: "all-prompts"` 的标题 provider：**每条人类消息之后**都会用
「字节预算内最近的人类消息」重新生成一次标题。它**不替换**核心的 `session-title` 服务，
而是注册进它（和官方 provider 同一个扩展点）。

顺带解决一个相关问题：**回合边界自动状态前缀**。如果团队约定「干活写【运行】、收尾写【完成】」，
只靠 agent 自觉去写，实测绝大多数会话都不会有标记；本插件在 `turn/start` / `turn/end`
边界自动把前缀写上（前缀文案可配置，不想用可以关）。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 为什么需要它：- **零第三方依赖**：只用 `node:fs` / `node:os` / `node:path`（`node:zlib` 只在验证脚本里用）。
- **零主包 import**：插件随 profile 部署，运行期解析不到全局 npm 里的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，
  因此事件名 / 服务名**内联**在 `lib/host-protocol.js` 一个文件里（升级主包时只核对这一处）。
- **不读会话文件**：只订阅会话事件、只 append `session/title` 事件（写标题是主包公开的事件契约）。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 一、能力：| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 实时重生成标题 | 每条人类消息后重新生成；选材 = 上一版标题的依据（**主题锚**）+ 最近消息，按字节预算收拢 |
| 不覆盖人工改名 | 你在 GUI 里手动改过标题之后，本插件不再动它（**pin**，与打标路径共用同一份判定） |
| 回合边界状态前缀 | `turn/start` → `【运行】`，`turn/end` → `【完成】`（文案可配、可关） |
| 预置标题保护 | 会话创建阶段已写好的标题（任务卡 / 外部流程预置）：只换前缀、不被摘要顶掉 |
| 自建调度 | 主包的自动调度在首轮之后拿不到启动时机（见 `lib/index.js` 文件头），所以本插件自己在 `llm/stream` 钩子里触发；两条通路由**轮次认领**去重，一轮最多一次生成 |
| 最小信息门槛 | 已有标题时，本轮新增消息太少（默认 < 20 字）就不重生成，避免「好」「收到」这类短噪声把标题带跑 |
| 活开关 | 一个 JSON 文件 / 一个环境变量即可停掉（**不重启**），关掉后零写入、零 token |
| 主线名直写（可选） | 宿主侧有「会话 → 主线」账本时，标题直接写主线名（不猜、不花模型调用）；账本缺失即回落自动生成，两条触发链都拦（见第六节） |
| 子代理会话跳过 | 子代理 / 派生会话不打标、不生成 |

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 二、前置条件：- DSH 主包 `>= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0`（兼容性细节见第七节）
- Node.js `>= 18`
- 一个能改 `profiles/<name>/` 的 DSH 安装（默认 profile 名为 `web`）

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. 注册插件（只有「手工装法」要这一步）：**走方式 0 就跳过本节** —— bundle 层已经把插件插好了。下面只给手工装（方式 A/B/C）用。

把 [`cordis.patch.yml.example`](./cordis.patch.yml.example) 的 `insert` 段追加到
`profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-title-live
      name: '@kira905/dsh-session-title-live'
```

**必须**同时关掉官方「只在首轮生成标题」的 provider（`session-title-llm`）：
两条 provider 注册的是同一个 provider id，同时挂载时后一个会报
`session-title provider "dsh-session-title-live" is already registered`、整条 entry 不激活
（隔离实例实测）。所以手工装时也要加：

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. 注册插件（只有「手工装法」要这一步）：```yaml
- id: session-title-llm
  disabled: true
```

> 写法注意：宿主认的是**针对某一条的覆盖** `id` + `disabled: true`；`disable:` 列表**不是**
> loader patch 的语法，会被静默跳过（只在 `--dump-config` 里留一行
> `patch: id is required for non-insert patches`）。

⚠️ `insert` 的 `id` 不能与已有条目重复（重复会崩 `duplicate loader entry id`）；上面两段都加时，
别把 `insert` 加两遍。加之前先查：

```bash
grep -n "id:" <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml
```

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 3. 重启并验证：重启 DSH（或让它的守护进程拉起新配置），然后在 GUI 里：

1. 随便开一个会话，发一条消息 → 侧边栏标题应该在几秒内变成与新内容相关的；
2. 再发几条不相关的消息 → 标题会跟着变（不是停在第一条）；
3. 手动把标题改一下 → 此后本插件不再覆盖它；
4. 想确认插件真的加载了：日志里应有一行
   `[dsh-session-title-live] registered: all-prompts live title provider｜route=… selfSchedule=true …`。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 四、配置：三层合并，**后者覆盖前者**：

1. `lib/config.js` 里的默认值（即[示例文件](./examples/session-title-live.config.example.json)里的值）；
2. `SESSION_TITLE_LIVE_CONFIG` 指向的 JSON 文件（**不设这个环境变量就不会读任何文件**）；
3. 宿主 `cordis.patch.yml` 里该插件 `config:` 段。

对象段（`marks` / `killSwitch`）**深合并**（只覆盖你写的那几个键）；非法值会被清洗成默认值
并打一条 `warn` 日志（不会让插件起不来）。

目录解析（`home`）走 `SESSION_TITLE_LIVE_HOME` > `DSH_HOME` > `~/.dsh`，跨平台，**没有机器路径硬编码**。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 四、配置：| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `targetWords` | `5` | 非 CJK 语言的标题目标词数（只写进提示词） |
| `targetCjkCharacters` | `10` | CJK 目标字数（只写进提示词） |
| `maxInputBytes` | `32768` | 送进模型的输入字节预算（超了从最新消息往前收拢） |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `128` | 标题输出 token 上限 |
| `maxTitleBytes` | `80` | 标题落盘的 UTF-8 字节上限（与主包标题上限一致） |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单次生成超时 |
| `provider` / `model` | 不设 | **成对**配置则用独立路由生成标题；都不写 = 跟随会话主请求的路由 |
| `promptIntro` | 见示例 | 送进模型的 JSON 数组前的引导句 |
| `systemPrompt` | 不设 | 自定义系统提示词（字符串或字符串数组），省略 = 内置 |
| `selfSchedule` | `true` | 自建调度总开关（`false` = 退回主包调度原状，多数情况下标题就不会刷新了） |
| `selfScheduleMaxHumans` | `32` | 每会话内存里保留的人类消息条数上限 |
| `minIncrementChars` | `20` | 最小值门槛：新增字数低于它就不重生成（`0` = 关） |
| `themeAnchorMax` | `6` | 主题锚（上一版标题依据）保留条数上限（`0` = 关锚） |
| `turnMarks` | `true` | 回合边界自动打前缀总开关 |
| `markBaseBudgetBytes` | `64` | 加前缀前的基名字节预算 |
| `markProvider` | `dsh-session-title-live#turn-mark` | 打标写回时 `source.provider` 的名字（用于识别"这条是我们写的"） |
| `marks.prefix` | `{running:'【运行】', done:'【完成】'}` | 状态 → 前缀文本 |
| `marks.textToState` | `{运行:running, 完成:done, 待命:idle, 已中断:interrupted}` | 前缀文本 → 状态（**键不要带括号**） |
| `marks.relayAxis` | `['续', '已交接']` | 接力轴词表（**只保留、从不自己写**；键

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 四、配置：> ⚠️ 改了 `marks.prefix` 记得让 `marks.textToState` 能认出你写出去的前缀形状。
> 本插件把**两个来源合并**成识别表（`prefix` 的字面值 + `textToState` 的键），所以像 `[RUN]`
> 这种自定义前缀也能被认出来、不会在下一轮叠一层；但如果你把前缀改成"无包裹"的裸词（例如 `运行 `），
> 建议同时把它加进 `textToState` 以免误伤正文。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 五、状态前缀（回合边界）：- `turn/start` → 标题写成 `【运行】<基名>`；`turn/end` → `【完成】<基名>`。
- 只换前缀、不动基名；前缀已经是当前状态就不重复写（幂等）。
- **绝不用 `rename`**：`rename` 会把标题 pin 住（主包认定那是人工改名），自动标题从此不再调度。
  本插件用 `append('session/title', { source: { kind: 'provider' } })` —— 只覆盖"当前标题"的显示值。
- 人工改名（`source.kind === 'user'`）之后不再打标、不再重生成基名。
- 已知来源三种（对真实实例核对过）：`user`（人工改名 / 外部预置）、`provider`（自动生成，含本插件）、
  `fallback`（主包在还没有标题时的确定性兜底）。只有 `user` 会被当成 pin，`fallback` 会被正常覆盖。

section: 账本格式（本插件只读，不写）

text:
@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 行为：| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 会话命中主线名 | 标题写成 `主线名`（标题上有接力轴时写成 `【续】主线名`）；**一次标题模型调用都不花** |
| 基名已经是这条主线名 | 一条事件都不写（幂等） |
| 账本不存在 / 损坏 / 没这条会话 | 回落自动生成（**fail-open**） |
| 同一会话命中两条**不同名**主线 | 不猜，回落自动生成，并打一条 `warn` 日志 |
| 预置标题的会话（任务卡等） | **不套**主线名（侧边栏靠那个标题认任务） |

关掉：`"mainline": { "enabled": false }`。
换目录：`"mainline": { "ledgerDir": "<绝对路径或相对 home 的目录名>" }`。

> 为什么两条触发链都要拦：自建调度与主包服务是**两条独立触发链**，谁后写谁赢 ——
> 只拦一条的话，主线名会被另一条周期性覆盖掉。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 接力轴（`【续】` / `【已交接】`）：标题上可能同时叠**两层**前缀，来源不同、命运也不同：

- **状态轴**（`【运行】` / `【完成】`）：本插件按回合边界**每轮重写**；
- **接力轴**（默认 `【续】` / `【已交接】`，见 `marks.relayAxis`）：交接 / 接力脚本写入的，
  本插件**只保留、从不自己写**，也绝不把它当状态轴吃掉。

最终形态 = `【状态】【接力轴】基名`（例如 `【运行】【续】迁移脚本收尾`）。
基名自带的方括号（如 `【跨模块】X`）不受影响 —— 只剥词表内的前缀、最多三层。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 八、已知限制：1. **依赖主包的私有事件 / 服务名**。本插件不是官方插件，主包改名字就会失效（现象：标题不再刷新，
   日志里可能一片安静）。复核入口只有一个文件：`lib/host-protocol.js`。
2. **标题生成失败时保留旧标题**（不重试）：LLM 超时 / 报错 / 输出为空都会走"失败"路径，
   主包保留上一版标题；下一条人类消息到来时会自然再试一次。
3. **最小信息门槛会让某些轮次不刷新**：只发「好」这类短消息时，标题保持上一版（这是故意的，
   为了不被噪声带跑）。想退回旧行为把 `minIncrementChars` 设为 `0`。
4. **人工改名之后就不再自动更新了**（pin 是设计，不是 bug）。想恢复自动：在 GUI 里让标题
   回到"provider 来源"没有直接入口 —— 换一个会话最省事。
5. **自建调度默认开启**（`selfSchedule: true`）。它是为绕开主包调度的时机限制而存在的；
   关掉它多数情况下就没有实时刷新了，只在排障对照时才关。
6. **`bundles` 加载方式已实测（0.2.5 起）**：本插件现在自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle`），在隔离实例
   （独立 `DSH_HOME` + 端口 3090 + 主包 `0.2.0-rc.2`）上用 `dsh plugin --profile bundlecheck add <tgz>` 装本地 tgz，
   启动日志只有 `dsh web: http://…` 一行、无 `declares no dsh.bundle`、无 entry 未激活；
   `--dump-config` 里能看到本插件行，且官方 `session-title-llm` 标着 `patched by @kira905/dsh-session-title-live`。
7. **群聊 / 多用户场景未评估**：本插件按"人类消息 = `source.kind==='user'`"取文本，
   若你的部署里有多来源消息，选材口径需自行核对。
8. **`0.1.5` 线只做过静态核对、未端到端实测**（见第七节）。

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · dsh-session-title-live：> ### What this is
> **A small plugin**: keep session titles in step with their state (running / done), without disturbing titles you pinned.
>
> ### What it solves
> With a dozen sessions in the sidebar, the titles alone cannot tell you which are working and which finished hours ago. This plugin writes the state prefix straight into the title, and treats "automatic title updates" and "the user pinned this" as two separate things — a pinned title is never touched.
>
> ### Run it in one command
> ```powershell
> dsh plugin --profile web add @kira905/dsh-session-title-live
> ```
> Titles then carry their state prefix automatically; the rules are configurable in the plugin settings.
>
> ### What it looks like
> Sidebar titles read like "[running] …" / "[done] …". ⚠️ **No screenshot in this repo.**

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · dsh-session-title-live：---

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin** that makes session titles **update live as the conversation goes**.

> **Status**: published (Gitee + GitHub)
> **Repository**: <https://github.com/kira905/dsh-session-title-live> ｜ <https://gitee.com/kira905/dsh-session-title-live>
> **License**: AGPL-3.0 (pending a final decision) — see [License](#license) and [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)
> **中文**: [README.md](./README.md)

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Why it is needed：It also solves a related problem along the way: **automatic state prefixes at turn boundaries**. If a team convention says "mark running work with [running] and finished work with [done]", relying on the agent to do it voluntarily means that, in practice, almost no session ever gets marked; this plugin applies the prefix automatically at the `turn/start` / `turn/end` boundaries (the prefix text is configurable, and the whole thing can be turned off).

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Why it is needed：- **Zero third-party dependencies**: only `node:fs` / `node:os` / `node:path` (`node:zlib` is used only by a verification script).
- **Zero host-package imports**: the plugin is deployed with the profile and cannot resolve the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages in the global npm tree at runtime,
  so event names and service names are **inlined** in a single file, `lib/host-protocol.js` (a host upgrade means checking that one place).
- **It does not read session files**: it only subscribes to session events and only appends `session/title` events (writing a title is a public event contract of the host).

- **Its compatibility window with the host** → see *Multi-machine Handoff and Cloud Relay* **§4.5 "compatibility requirements"** (see also section 7, "Compatibility", of this README)
- **This component's own pitfalls and measurements** → the "Known limitations" section of this README

|---|---|
| Live title regeneration | Regenerated after every human message; the source material is the basis of the previous title (the **theme anchor**) plus the most recent messages, packed down to fit the byte budget |
| Manual renames are never overwritten | Once you have renamed a title by hand in the GUI, this plugin leaves it alone (**pin**, judged by the same rule the prefix path uses) |
| Turn-boundary state prefix | `turn/start` → `【运行】`, `turn/end` → `【完成】` (the text is configurable and can be turned off) |
| Pre-set title protection | A title already written during session creation (task card / external flow): only its prefix is swapped, it is never displaced by a summary |
| Self-managed scheduling | The host's automatic scheduling cannot get a launch opportunity after the first turn (see the file header of `lib/index.js`), so this plugin triggers from the `llm/stream` hook itself; the two routes are de-duplicated by **turn claim**, so a turn generates at most once |
| Minimum-information threshold | When a title already exists and this turn added too little text (default: fewer than 20

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. Register the plugin (manual routes only)：**Skip this step when you used Route 0** — the bundle layer already inserted the plugin. What follows is for the manual routes (A/B/C) only.

Append the `insert` block from [`cordis.patch.yml.example`](./cordis.patch.yml.example) to the end of
`profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-title-live
      name: '@kira905/dsh-session-title-live'
```

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. Register the plugin (manual routes only)：You **must** also disable the official first-turn provider (`session-title-llm`): both register
the same provider id, so leaving both mounted makes the later one fail with
`session-title provider "dsh-session-title-live" is already registered` and the entry does not
activate (measured on an isolated instance). Manual routes therefore need:

```yaml
- id: session-title-llm
  disabled: true
```

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. Register the plugin (manual routes only)：> Syntax note: the host reads an **id-targeted override** (`id` + `disabled: true`); a `disable:`
> list is **not** part of the loader patch format and is silently skipped (it only shows up as
> `patch: id is required for non-insert patches` in `--dump-config`).

⚠️ The `id` of an `insert` entry must not duplicate an existing entry (a duplicate crashes with `duplicate loader entry id`); when you add both blocks, do not add `insert` twice. Check before adding:

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 2. Register the plugin (manual routes only)：```bash
grep -n "id:" <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml
```

> Since 0.2.5 this package declares `dsh.bundle` (root `cordis.patch.yml`), so it can be installed as a profile layer (Route 0, recommended) **or** registered by hand as above — **do not mix the two**, because registering the same id twice crashes startup.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 4. Configuration：> ⚠️ If you change `marks.prefix`, remember to keep `marks.textToState` able to recognise the shape of the prefix you write out.
> This plugin **merges both sources** into one recognition table (the literal values of `prefix` plus the keys of `textToState`), so a custom prefix
> such as `[RUN]` is still recognised and will not be stacked again on the next turn; but if you change the prefix to a bare, unwrapped word
> (for example `running `), consider adding it to `textToState` as well so that ordinary body text is not caught by mistake.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Kill switch：- **fail-safe**: if the file cannot be read / holds broken JSON / has no key for this module → **keep working** (a missing file is not a request to switch off).
- **Environment variable**: `SESSION_TITLE_LIVE_DISABLED=1` stops it immediately (it takes precedence over the file; useful in containers / CI).
- Once off: no prefixes, no generation, **zero writes and zero tokens** (read fresh at every turn / before every generation, effective within ≤3s, no restart needed).

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 5. State prefixes (turn boundaries)：- `turn/start` → the title becomes `【运行】<base name>`; `turn/end` → `【完成】<base name>` (those are the shipped default prefix strings — `running` and `done` in CJK brackets — and they are configurable).
- Only the prefix is swapped, the base name is left alone; if the prefix already matches the current state it is not written again (idempotent).
- **`rename` is never used**: `rename` pins the title (the host takes it for a manual rename) and automatic titles are never scheduled again.
  This plugin uses `append('session/title', { source: { kind: 'provider' } })` — it only overrides the displayed value of the "current title".
- After a manual rename (`source.kind === 'user'`) no prefix is applied and the base name is not regenerated.
- Three sources are known (checked against a real instance): `user` (manual rename / external pre-set), `provider` (generated automatically, including by this plugin),
  and `fallback` (the host's deterministic fallback before a title exists). Only `user` counts as a pin; `fallback` is overwritten normally.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 6. Mainline names (optional)：An automatic title is, in the end, a guess made from the last few human messages. If your host
already keeps a "session → mainline" ledger (task boards, handoffs and relay workflows all produce
one), the title does not have to guess: writing the mainline name is steadier, cheaper, and stops
the same piece of work being titled differently on every turn.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Ledger format (read-only for this plugin)：- `_lines.json` is the **only source of names**; `_sids/*.jsonl` only records which session
  belongs to which line (append-only).
- A `sid` is normalized (leading `session-` stripped, lower-cased) before it is compared with the
  current session id.
- The ledger is **maintained by you**; this plugin only reads it and only understands the shape above.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Behaviour：| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| The session matches a mainline name | The title becomes the name (with the relay axis kept, e.g. `【续】name`); **no title-model call at all** |
| The base name already is that name | Nothing is written (idempotent) |
| Ledger missing / corrupt / session not listed | Falls back to automatic generation (**fail-open**) |
| The session matches two mainlines with **different names** | No guessing: falls back and logs a `warn` |
| Sessions with a pre-set title (task cards etc.) | The mainline name is **not** applied (the sidebar relies on that title) |

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Behaviour：Disable with `"mainline": { "enabled": false }`; relocate with
`"mainline": { "ledgerDir": "<absolute path or a directory name under home>" }`.

> Why both trigger chains are gated: the self-scheduler and the host service are **two independent
> chains**, and the later writer wins — gating only one lets the other overwrite the name periodically.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Relay axis (`【续】` / `【已交接】`)：A title can carry **two** prefix layers, written by different parties:

- **State axis** (`【运行】` / `【完成】`): rewritten by this plugin on every turn boundary.
- **Relay axis** (default `【续】` / `【已交接】`, see `marks.relayAxis`): written by handoff / relay
  scripts. This plugin **preserves it and never writes it**, and never eats it as a state prefix.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · Relay axis (`【续】` / `【已交接】`)：Final shape = `【state】【relay】base` (e.g. `【运行】【续】migration wrap-up`). Bracketed words that are
not in the dictionary (e.g. `【cross-module】X`) are left alone — only dictionary prefixes are
stripped, at most three layers deep.

@kira905/dsh-session-title-live README · 8. Known limitations：1. **It depends on the host's private event and service names.** This plugin is not an official plugin, and a host rename breaks it (the symptom: titles stop refreshing,
   and the log may be entirely silent). There is exactly one file to review: `lib/host-protocol.js`.
2. **A failed title generation keeps the old title** (no retry): an LLM timeout / error / empty output all take the "failure" path,
   the host keeps the previous title, and the next human message naturally tries again.
3. **The minimum-information threshold leaves some turns unrefreshed**: when you only send a short message such as "ok", the title keeps the previous version (this is deliberate,
   so that noise cannot drag it off course). To go back to the old behaviour, set `minIncrementChars` to `0`.
4. **After a manual rename there are no more automatic updates** (a pin is the design, not a bug). To restore automation: there is no direct entry point in the GUI
   for putting a title back to "provider source" — switching to another session is the simplest way.
5. **Self-managed scheduling is on by default** (`selfSchedule: true`). It exists to work aro
